If the charges are valid we need to understand options for smoothing the impact — FintechCo is mid-quarter and this will materially affect budgeting. Is there any one-time relief or a short-term discounted rate you can extend while we lock down our usage guards?

I've attached the invoice (invoice_MAY_2026_stub.pdf). Please loop in whoever you need.

Thanks,

Sean / Marissa — I pulled the request traces and a short summary:
- Spike window: 2026-05-28 03:10 - 2026-05-28 03:47 UTC (~37 minutes).
- Token throughput during window: ~3.2M tokens/min peak (baseline 120k tokens/min).
- Trigger: a single customer route (POST /api/generate) with continuous-batch size runaway after a client-side retry loop.
- KV cache hit rate dropped to 14% for that route, so effective cost per token increased.

Recommendation:
1) Short-term: provision an emergency quota bump for 48-72 hours to avoid throttling while we remediate.
2) Billing mitigation: offer a limited-scope surcharge discount for the overrun window (propose 20-30% of the surge line back to customer) while we confirm root cause.
3) Controls: enable hard quota + webhook alerts for future small windows.

I can produce a >1 page telemetry summary if Finance needs more detail.

- Vanessa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Note: attaching a short CSV export of the trace (internal use) — run_trace_0528.csv

Hi all — looping Alaia back into billing options. From a sales-ops/finance path we typically handle one of the following:
- One-time pro-rated credit against the surge line (applied to June invoice).
- A temporary discount on surge rates for a defined window (e.g., 30 days) plus an invoice adjustment.
- Waive a percentage as a goodwill gesture (requires manager approval for >15%).

Invoice note: invoice_MAY_2026 has surcharge line S-8274 (current amount $21,842). If we do a credit, accounting needs a formal amendment or approval email thread to attach.

My suggestion to resolve quickly: offer a 25% credit on the surcharge line + a 30-day reduced surge rate (20% off) while customer implements hard quota and webhook alerts. If Alaia accepts, I'll prepare the invoice adjustment stub and a short amendment (DocuSign) for signature.

Attachment: invoice_adjustment_stub.pdf (proposal)

Sean — quick note on precedent and risk:
- We have authorized up to 20% one-time credits for small customers in the past without manager sign-off. For larger overages (>$20k) we typically require director approval.
- For retention and to avoid repeated concessions, the package should include: a) a one-time credit, and b) hard quota + webhook alerting turned on, and c) a short amendment limiting future surge liability without change control.

If you think FintechCo is strategic (they're an active POC in our pipeline), I can approve a 25% credit as a one-time exception, plus the 30-day discounted surge rate Marissa proposed. We should require the signed amendment before applying the credit to the June invoice.

Lauren

Hi Alaia — thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Short summary and proposed remediation package below.

What happened:
- Telemetry indicates a client-side retry loop after a 3AM deploy on 2026-05-28 that generated a sustained 37-minute spike and dropped KV cache efficiency. That produced the surcharge line on your May invoice. Vanessa has the trace export if you want deep details.

Our proposal to mitigate impact (FintechCo-focused surge liability mitigation):
1) One-time credit of 25% on the surcharge line S-8274 ($5,460 credit applied to June invoice).
2) Temporary discounted surge tier for the next 30 days: 20% off standard surge rates to give you breathing room as you stabilize.
3) We'll provision a 72-hour emergency quota buffer (non-billable) while you deploy the fix.
4) We will enable hard quota + webhook alerting on the affected route and share the telemetry export.

Next steps (fast path):
- Please confirm acceptance of the package by reply.
- Marissa will send a short amendment (DocuSign link) for signature; we will not apply the credit until the signed amendment is returned, per policy.
- Vanessa is happy to run a quick joint post-mortem with your engineering team to avoid recurrence.
